query:
SELECT 
  c.nome,
  c.empresaSlug,
  c.cashbarberProfissionalId,
  COALESCE(fc.totalServicos, 0) as totalServicos,
  COALESCE(fc.totalProdutos, 0) as totalProdutos,
  COALESCE(fc.totalServicos + fc.totalProdutos, 0) as totalGeral
FROM colaboradores c
LEFT JOIN faturamentoColaboradores fc 
  ON fc.colaboradorId = c.id 
  AND fc.mes = 3 AND fc.ano = 2026
WHERE c.empresaSlug = 'MASCOTE'
ORDER BY totalGeral DESC;
